turns.content: Yaar meri shaadi mein six weeks bache hain. Rohan ko haldi mein hona hai, toast bhi dena hai — first year college se mera bhai hai. Par jab bhi Bangalore se travel ki baat karta hoon, bas "dekhte hain yaar, pakka try karunga." Main khud hi uski flight book kar doon kya, khatam jhanjhat?

Yaar, I completely understand your frustration. Shaadi ke sirf 6 weeks bache hain, stress level vaise hi high hoga, aur upar se jab sabse pakka dost aisi gol-gol baatein kare toh gussa aana bilkul normal hai. Haldi aur toast ke bina toh shaadi adhuri lagti hai!

But, flight book karne se pehle thoda ruko. 

Agar tumne flight book kar bhi di, aur asli problem kuch aur hui—jaise office se leave na milna, koi bada project, ya koi aur personal issue—toh baat aur awkward ho jayegi. Phir use guilt feel hoga aur tumhara paisa bhi waste ho sakta hai.

Mera sujhav yeh hai ki tum usse ek baar seedhe aur dosti waale haq se baat karo. Phone ghumao aur bol: 

*"Bhai, dekh, tu mera first year se yaar hai. Tere bina meri haldi aur toast ka koi matlab nahi hai. Mujhe sach bata, scene kya hai? Chhutti ka chakkar hai, paise ka scene hai, ya kuch aur? Agar tu travel ka soch ke pareshan hai, toh chal flight main book kar deta hoon, tu bas aa ja."*

Isse use samajh aayega ki tum uski kitni fikar kar rahe ho, aur agar koi genuine problem hogi toh woh khul kar bata dega. 

Kya lagta hai? Ek baar khul kar baat karke dekhein?

Maine check kiya, nau hazaar ki return flight hai, koi bada amount nahi. Usne do mahine pehle job switch kiya, koi startup hai. Aur aajkal uske replies bhi two-word aate hain, pehle voice notes bhejta tha. Bol raha hoon khud ko ki busy hoga, par hafton se yahi chal raha hai.

Yaar, main samajh sakta hoon. Yeh ab sirf 9,000 rupaye ki baat nahi reh gayi hai. Baat dosti ki hai, aur jo badlaav tum dekh rahe ho, woh sach mein chubhta hai. Jo banda voice notes bhejta tha, ab do-do words mein reply kar raha hai—yeh dukh deta hai, khaas kar tab jab tumhari zindagi ka itna bada din aa raha ho.

Par ek baat par dhyan do—**usne do mahine pehle hi startup join kiya hai.** 

Startup life sach mein bahut zyada hectic aur unpredictable hoti hai. Aur jab nayi-nayi job ho (sirf 2 mahine), toh insaan par apna impact banane ka bohot pressure hota hai. Ho sakta hai woh probation par ho, use chhutti maangne mein darr lag raha ho, ya phir woh kaam ke bojh ke neeche dabba hua ho. Jab dimaag exhausted hota hai na, toh sabse pehle communication hi affect hoti hai—isiliye shayad woh do-word replies de raha hai. 

Mera dil kehta hai ki woh aana toh chahta hai, par shayad phase aisa chal raha hai ki woh dhang se manage nahi kar pa raha.

Ek kaam karo, shaadi aur flight ki baat ko do minute ke liye side rakho. Aaj ya kal mein use ek simple sa message dalo, bina kisi pressure ke:

*"Bhai, main dekh raha hoon tu kaafi busy chal raha hai aajkal. Nayi job kaisi chal rahi hai? Sab theek toh hai na? Tu zyada stress mat le, jab time mile aaram se baat kariyo."*

Jab tum usse shaadi ke dulhe ki tarah nahi, balki uske purane yaar ki tarah poochoge, toh ho sakta hai woh khul kar apni pareshani bataye. Uska reply dekh kar phir flight book karne ka decision lena. 

Tumhe kya lagta hai? Uska stress level check karein pehle?

Sach bolun toh ab bura lagne laga hai. Agar sach mein care karta toh pehle din haan bol deta na? Soch raha hoon aaj raat call karke seedha puchh loon — "bhai aa raha hai ya nahi, haan ya na." Kam se kam pata toh chalega main kahan khada hoon.

Yaar, bura lagna bilkul natural hai. Tumhara hurt hona 100% justified hai. Shaadi life ka itna bada event hai, aur agar sabse pakka dost hi dhang se respond na kare, toh dimaag mein yeh aana lazmi hai ki *"kya sirf main hi is dosti ko seriously le raha hoon?"* 

Call karne ka tumhara decision bilkul sahi hai. Text par baatein aksar kharab lagti hain, call par aawaz sun kar sach samajh aata hai.

Bas ek choti si dostana salah—jab tum aaj raat call karo na, toh **"haan ya na" waala ultimatum dene ke bajaye, thoda haq aur thodi vulnerability ke saath baat karna.** 

Agar tum seedha ultimatum doge, toh ho sakta hai woh pressure mein aakar defensive ho jaye, ya darr ke maare seedha "na" bol de—jo tum bilkul nahi chahte. 

Tum phone par seedhe bol sakte ho:
*"Bhai, dekh, main gussa nahi hoon par sach bolun toh mujhe thoda bura lag raha hai. Tu mera sabse khaas dost hai, aur tere bina meri shaadi adhuri hai. Mujhe bas sach bata de chal kya raha hai? Nayi job ka pressure hai ya koi aur baat? Jo bhi hai, khul ke bol."*

Isse use tumhara gussa nahi, tumhara pyaar aur dosti dikhegi. Aur use samajh aayega ki tum use miss kar rahe ho, uspar chilla nahi rahe.

Aaj raat call karo yaar. Dil halka ho jayega aur clear picture bhi mil jayegi. Main yahin hoon, call ke baad batana kya hua, theek hai? All the best!

Meri fiancée bol rahi hai main overthink kar raha hoon, woh bas busy hoga. Par yeh wahi banda hai jo 2019 mein meri behen ki shaadi ke liye overnight bus se aaya tha. Kuch toh badla hai aur samajh nahi aa raha kya, aur haldi se do hafte pehle main usse naraaz baitha hoon, yeh feeling hi ganda hai.

Tumhari fiancée tumhe shaadi ke stress se bachane ke liye bol rahi hai, par tumhari feeling bilkul sahi hai—tum overthink nahi kar rahe ho. Jab ek banda 2019 mein overnight bus pakad ke aa sakta hai, aur aaj flight ke naam par "dekhte hain" bol raha hai, toh badlaav toh aaya hai. Tum use sabse behtar jaante ho, isiliye tumhara dil yeh samajh raha hai.

Aur yeh jo "naraaz baithne" waali feeling hai na haldi se pehle, yeh sach mein bahut gandi aur bhaari hoti hai. Tumhe apni shaadi ki khushi manani chahiye, na ki apne sabse pakke dost se dori mehsoos karni chahiye.

Pata hai, ho sakta hai dosti badli na ho, par **Rohan ki life ki situation badal gayi ho.** 2019 mein shayad woh college mein tha ya career ke shuruat mein, tab dimaag par woh zimmedariyan aur corporate pressure nahi tha jo aaj ek startup ki nayi job mein hai. Kabhi-kabhi jab insaan mentally bahut pareshan ya exhausted hota hai, toh woh apne sabse pyaare doston se bhi piche hatne lagta hai kyunki usme energy nahi bachti.

Yeh narazgi aur dori tumhare dimaag mein chal rahi hai, par Rohan ko shayad andaza bhi nahi hai ki tum is waqt kis dukh se guzar rahe ho. 

Isiliye aaj raat ka call bohot zaroori hai. Use gusse mein nahi, usi 2019 waale dosti ke haq se call karo. Jab tum usse bologe na ki *"Bhai, tu behen ki shaadi mein overnight bus se aaya tha, tere bina main apni shaadi kaise imagine karoon?"*—toh agar woh kisi baat se pareshan bhi hoga, uska dil pighal jayega.

Apne dil par se yeh bojh utar do aaj raat. Call karo, aur use batao ki tum use kitna miss kar rahe ho. Phir jo bhi hoga, kam se kam tumhare dimaag mein yeh dukh aur confusion toh nahi rahega. 

Gabrao mat, go with a warm heart. Mujhe batana usne kya bola, okay?
